author: boris.plavljanic

title: Best Habit Tracker on the market!
body:
I’ve been using HabitKit for almost a year already (Yearly Pro Sub), and I must say it’s been an amazing experience. 

The app offers everything one could need in managing all of their habits. It’s trully a polished and well designed app. In addition to that, the developer is very responsive (replies frequently to emails and feedback), publishes frequest updates with even more additions and improvements to the app, which makes it that much better!

Again, huge recommendation for HabitKit, insane app for a very affordable price point! :)

Thanks Sebastian for creating this amazing product. 👌🏻💯
author: xNevaM
